description: Deutschlandatlas Verfügbarkeit von mobilem Breitband is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesministerium für Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen. Data from www.deutschlandatlas.bund.de: Best possible mobile phone coverage per grid cell in 2022. In almost all municipalities, there is an almost complete supply of LTE and 5G. This includes bandwidths of at least 2 megabits per second (Mbit/s). Download rates of 2 Mbit/s are considered a lower limit for meaningful use. Coverage: Bundesministerium für Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen. The portal shows the English title as "Deutschlandatlas Availability of mobile broadband" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bundesministerium für Wohnen, Stadtentwicklung und Bauwesen. Its keywords include Downloadrate, opendata, Online-Dienst, Mbit/s, UMTS, mobile. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
